reason: A notification plugin that monitors supported AI coding harness events and reads final replies, approval requests, and questions aloud through the host operating system's speech synthesis.

summaries.zh: 通过系统语音合成功能播报 AI 编程助手的最终回复、审批请求和问题，帮助用户无需持续盯屏即可获知任务状态。
summaries.en: Announces AI coding harness replies, approval requests, and questions through the host operating system's speech synthesis so users can stay informed without watching the screen.

capabilities: Reads final assistant replies and selected approval or question events from supported harnesses
Converts text to speech using Windows SAPI or macOS say
Installs or registers local harness hooks and configuration files
Provides configurable speech rate, volume, text limits, and voice selection
